majorDuties.duty: Issue environmental permits and resource-use authorizations as the deciding authority

tasks.statement: Review a permit application for administrative and technical completeness, issuing a deficiency notice that lists each missing element and its basis
Derive permit limits and conditions from the applicable technical standards and the facility's technical record, documenting the calculation basis for each limit
Draft a permit and its fact sheet so that each condition is measurable, enforceable and traceable to its legal or technical basis
Review an AI-drafted permit or fact sheet against the application record and permit template, correcting each condition that lacks a traceable basis
Respond to public comments on a draft permit, revising conditions where a comment shows an error and explaining each decision in the response document

majorDuties.duty: Draft enforceable, implementable binding instruments

tasks.statement: Write policy or instrument language that states each obligation, obligated party, deadline and verification method so that compliance can be determined
Test draft permit conditions or agreement terms against compliance-verification and legal-challenge scenarios, recording each term revised and why
Verify each term of an AI-generated first draft of an instrument against the governing authority and record before the draft enters review

majorDuties.duty: Map the decision authority and procedural pathway for a proposed action

tasks.statement: Review a project proposal to identify every authorization, consultation and review it triggers, recording the governing procedure version for each
Prepare an authority map and pathway plan for a multi-permit project, sequencing concurrent and dependent decisions and identifying the critical path

majorDuties.duty: Negotiate permit conditions, mitigation and agreements using interest-based methods

tasks.statement: Negotiate permit conditions or mitigation with an applicant, generating options that meet the governing requirements and recording the agreed terms
Prepare a negotiation brief stating own and counterpart interests, alternatives to agreement, the issue list and the limits of one's authority

majorDuties.duty: Operate within, or oversee, delegated and assumed regulatory programs

tasks.statement: Respond to an overseeing agency's objection to a permit issued under delegated authority, revising the permit or defending it with a written record
Assess whether a proposed change to program rules keeps them at least as stringent as the delegated authority requires, documenting each provision compared
Audit a local government's delivery of a delegated program against its agreement, issuing findings with the corrective actions required

majorDuties.duty: Process permit applications and administer issued authorizations

tasks.statement: Review automated eligibility and completeness checks on electronic permit applications, correcting misclassified applications before decisions are issued
Maintain permit records and electronic case files, tracking holders' reporting and expiry dates and referring missed conditions for follow-up
Explain permit conditions and environmental responsibilities to permit holders before use begins, recording each holder's acknowledgment of the conditions

majorDuties.duty: Track regulatory change and translate it into operating guidance

tasks.statement: Screen automated regulatory-change alerts for a program each week, confirming which items affect its decisions and recording why the rest do not
Update program procedures and templates to a new governing version, recording which pending actions follow the old and new versions

majorDuties.duty: Build and maintain a defensible administrative record

tasks.statement: Index documents into the administrative record with dates, authors and provenance labels, marking which content was produced with AI assistance
Write the reasoned explanation that links the evidence in the record to each choice made in a decision

majorDuties.duty: Provide compliance and technical assistance to regulated entities and local governments

tasks.statement: Answer compliance questions from regulated entities through a help line or portal, recording each question and the guidance given for consistency review

majorDuties.duty: Maintain independence and manage conflicts of interest across the regulator-regulated boundary

tasks.statement: Recuse from a decision or review in which a former employer or client has an interest, documenting the recusal and the reassignment of the work

majorDuties.duty: Validate AI-generated work products before professional use

tasks.statement: Check an AI-assisted regulatory analysis or compliance summary against the applicable legal text and source records before it enters a decision document.
